title: Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746)", at revision 1375254761, opens: "The Ottoman–Persian War of 1743–1746 or Ottoman–Iranian War of 1743–1746 was fought between the Ottoman Empire and Afsharid Iran." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4465891, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between the Ottoman Empire and the Afsharid Iran (1743-46)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
